key_idea: Each inequality is a directed edge between two of 26 letters; the list is paradoxical exactly when the directed graph has a cycle.
sketch: Parse 'a x b', orient the edge from the smaller to the larger variable, and run Kahn's topological sort on the 26-node graph; if not all nodes are removed there is a cycle, print ':(' else ':)'. Complexity is O(26^2). Pitfalls: the '>' direction must be flipped, and tokens are whitespace separated.
